review_description: In short I picked AES Technology for quality not price.  AES were local have been around for a while and the owner Reg was willing to indulge me in my endless questions about systems/size available to me and quality.  I wanted an expandable system and Reg provided some good options and advice.  The actual process took longer than expected but this was primarily due to my research and the availability of good quality inverters in Australia at the time - no fault of AES.   NSW also has issues related to the electricity suppliers not having enough 'back to grid' meters.  The popularity of the scheme has outstripped demand.  I was on a 2 month wait list after AES did a prompt and professional install.  AES did my REC's for me an the refund was more than expected.AES TechnologyPO Box 144Calwell ACT 29050430 8 SOLAR (76527)http://AEST.BIZinfo@aest.biz
